text: He froze the woman he loved, to save her life. Then his boss pulled the plug.
This is Gotham City, run by crime and money, where a masked vigilante called Batman hunts criminals by night.
Victor Fries was a scientist at GothCorp, a giant company. His work was cryogenics: freezing a living body, so time stops inside it.
His wife, Nora, was dying of an illness no doctor could cure.
So Victor froze her in a glass chamber, to wait for a cure. He kept a snow globe with a tiny skater inside. To him, it was Nora.
But he'd used the company's machines. The boss, Ferris Boyle, ordered them shut off.
Victor begged. Boyle kicked him into the freezing chemicals, and ran.
Nora's chamber went dark. Victor believed she was gone.
The chemicals changed his body. Now he could only survive below zero, inside a frozen suit.
He became Mister Freeze, and he hunted GothCorp to find the man who killed his wife.
Batman stopped him just before he froze Boyle alive. Then he found the security tape, and gave it to the news.
That explains his revenge. It doesn't excuse it.
Locked in a cell, Victor held the snow globe, and asked Nora to forgive him for failing her.
He could freeze anything in the world. But the only thing he ever wanted to keep was her.
